words.def: to deal with a difficult or unpleasant task directly
words.ex: I always {tackle} the bathroom first to get it out of the way.

words.def: not done when it should have been
words.ex: The hoovering is well {overdue}: I haven't done it in two weeks.

words.def: to divide something between two or more people
words.ex: We {split} the chores between us so it feels fair.

words.def: feeling treated unfairly and upset about it
words.ex: She felt {aggrieved} that she was always the one cleaning the bathroom.

words.def: in a way that can be depended on every time
words.ex: He {reliably} empties the bins every Sunday without being asked.

words.def: any job needed to keep a home clean and running
words.ex: Taking out the bin is a simple {household task}, but everyone hates it.

words.def: to fail to keep up with something that needs doing regularly
words.ex: When I'm busy at work, I always {fall behind} with the cleaning.

words.def: not too difficult to deal with
words.ex: If you clean a little each day, it stays {manageable}.
